consumer_route: START_CLIENT_TICK gates on player+interactive+no screen before while(wasPressed); accepted presses dispatch AUTO to HarvestSessionStore and ClientRequestSender; rejected precondition returns retain queued presses.
install loop i=0..<QuickSlotConfig.SLOT_COUNT; consumeQuickSlotPresses iterates slots in order and drains each while(wasPressed), calling quickSlotHandler.accept(i) for every press.
onTick requires player, then drains while(wasPressed) and invokes jiemaiHandler for every press; no currentScreen gate.
onTick requires player and polls isPressed edge; Botany input capture forces a release edge; handler receives hold true/false; no currentScreen gate.
onTick requires player, then drains while(wasPressed) and invokes eventStreamToggleHandler for every press; no currentScreen gate.
onTick requires player and polls isPressed edge, invoking shieldHoldHandler with hold true/false; no currentScreen gate.
END_CLIENT_TICK drains all while(wasPressed); absent player or open screen discards every queued press, otherwise each press cycles JuiceConfig and emits actionbar feedback.
END_CLIENT_TICK drains while(wasPressed); each press uses client.execute and opens CraftScreen unless already current.
END_CLIENT_TICK drains while(wasPressed); each press uses client.execute and opens VoidActionScreen unless already current.

END_CLIENT_TICK drains all three encounter queues when player absent, screen open, or encounter inactive; active give queue drains to one boolean then dispatches exact huiyuan_pill instance via sendGiveDanToElder.
END_CLIENT_TICK shares full gated drain; active refuse queue drains to one boolean and logs the no-protocol placeholder action.
END_CLIENT_TICK shares full gated drain; active delay queue drains to one boolean and logs the no-effect placeholder action.
END_CLIENT_TICK drains while(wasPressed); each press uses client.execute and opens ForgeScreen unless already current.
END_CLIENT_TICK has no player/screen gate; drains while(wasPressed) and toggles HudImmersionMode once per press.
END_CLIENT_TICK drains while(wasPressed), requestOpenScreen uses client.execute and opens IdentityPanelScreen unless already current; store listener refresh remains separate.
END_CLIENT_TICK returns before reading the queue when player absent or screen open; otherwise drains while(wasPressed) and routes each press through InteractKeyRouter.global().
END_CLIENT_TICK drains while(wasPressed), requestOpenScreen uses client.execute, snapshots crosshair BlockPos, and opens LingtianActionScreen.
END_CLIENT_TICK returns before reading queue when player absent; otherwise drains while(wasPressed), sending one mineral probe per press with a block target and no-op for empty crosshair.
END_CLIENT_TICK returns before reading queue when player absent or screen open; otherwise drains the queue to one boolean, routes DASH once, and sends movement action with resolved yaw.
END_CLIENT_TICK returns without reading queue when player absent or screen open; otherwise drains while(wasPressed) and toggles NpcInteractionLogStore once per press.
END_CLIENT_TICK returns before reading queue when player absent; otherwise drains while(wasPressed), sending gaze plus mark-coordinate for a block target and no-op for empty crosshair.
END_CLIENT_TICK drains while(wasPressed), requestOpenScreen uses client.execute and opens SpiritTreasureScreen unless already current.

END_CLIENT_TICK returns before reading queues when player/options absent; while(wasPressed && !extracting) sends start for nearest portal; when gate is false one queued press is consumed before loop exits and further queued presses remain.

END_CLIENT_TICK returns before reading queues when player/options absent; while(wasPressed && extracting) sends cancel; when gate is false one queued press is consumed before loop exits and further queued presses remain.

END_CLIENT_TICK returns before reading queue when player/options absent; while(wasPressed && SEARCHING) sends cancel; when gate is false one queued press is consumed before loop exits and further queued presses remain.
END_CLIENT_TICK drains while(wasPressed); each accepted click uses client.execute, applies shouldOpen, then opens CultivationScreen from PlayerStateStore.snapshot().
